planning.concreteToRepresentation: Paper/physical investigation → original accurate diagram → controlled model → meaning/vocabulary → bounded checked practice and transfer.

interaction.action: Manually controlled rigid-paper orthographic folding projection about actual candidate line; one-or-more versus all offered axis selection; vertical/horizontal constructive mirror-grid transfer.
interaction.feedback: Actual current response checked with deterministic domain truth; edits neutralise stale success and retry. Independent exploration keeps fixed practice meaning.
semanticBoundary: Core recognition remains atomic concept; bounded grid construction is support, not change to formal process/mastery role.
Reflection is exact geometry and rigid folding projection, not whole-shape rotation or equal-area bisection alone.
Auxiliary labels, strokes and supplied mascots are outside the mathematical figure; no perfect natural-world symmetry claim.

planning.optionalHelp: Short details help; adult/offline investigation and advanced optional exploration in body.html.
